description: This PHP source file defines the class TerminationReasonConfigurationDao, which is a Data Access Object (DAO) responsible for managing termination reason entities in the HRM system. It contains methods for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and listing termination reasons, as well as checking for existing reason names and IDs in use.

classes.name: TerminationReasonConfigurationDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing termination reasons within the HRM system, extending the base DAO functionalities with specific methods for termination reason entities.

methods.name: saveTerminationReason
methods.description: Persists a new or updated TerminationReason entity into the database.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonById
methods.description: Retrieves a termination reason entity by its unique ID.

methods.name: getExistingTerminationReasonIds
methods.description: Retrieves a list of existing termination reason IDs from a given list of IDs.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonByName
methods.description: Finds a termination reason entity by its name after trimming whitespace.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonList
methods.description: Returns a list of termination reasons based on filtering parameters.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonListPaginator
methods.description: Provides a paginator object for paginated retrieval of termination reasons.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonCount
methods.description: Returns the count of termination reasons matching certain filter criteria.

methods.name: deleteTerminationReasons
methods.description: Deletes termination reasons corresponding to a list of IDs.

methods.name: isExistingTerminationReasonName
methods.description: Checks if a termination reason with a given name already exists.

methods.name: getReasonIdsInUse
methods.description: Returns IDs of termination reasons currently in use by employee termination records.
